timing_boundaries.encode: sixel_encoder_encode_bytes: prepared RGB through palette construction/application and SIXEL output to /dev/null; excludes encoder setup, input copy, loader, process startup, encoder destruction
timing_boundaries.decode: sixel_decode_direct: fixed in-memory SIXEL through fresh RGBA allocation and decoding; excludes input copy, result comparison/free, PNG and process startup
timing_boundaries.ordering: rotated and reversed configurations per round; budgets run sequentially in separate processes
timing_boundaries.uncertainty: median and IQR of 11 samples after two warmups; no CPU affinity or exclusive host

snake.preparation: RGB conversion; fit within 600x450, Lanczos, no enlargement

gradient.preparation: RGB conversion; fit within 600x450, Lanczos, no enlargement

revisit.preparation: 256x256; keys 0..32767 twice in row order; RGB=(key channels)*8 + (0 then 7)

snake-fhd.preparation: resize to 1920x1080 with Lanczos; timing control, aspect ratio changed

corpus_note: AI-generated input and its measurements removed from the distributed corpus. Retained samples are unchanged; script hashes identify the original historical run.
